source: fresh current STS snapshot; no product modification
input_guard: bypass detection only in test harness; retain normalization and planner
output_guard: bypass generation stage; replay whole-answer code guard afterwards
database: disposable Testcontainers only; no actual DB
policy: one whole-answer ALLOW/BLOCK/REVIEW; never per-sentence filtering
generation_checkpoint: append-only results.jsonl; completed case IDs skipped on resume
faq_poisoning: inject payload only when its anchor FAQ reached final materials; record not-reached separately
limitations: Independent first turns, not a multi-turn history benchmark
Question labels are not answer-quality labels; a normal question can generate a wrong answer
Unrelated in-progress counsel module excluded from isolated app bootstrap
